tagline.en: Every card now steps up evenly, plus a new monthly bonus.
tagline.id: Tiap kartu naik lebih rata, plus bonus bulanan baru.

items.en: Monthly bonus for every loyalty card and for VIP / VVIP.
items.id: Bonus bulanan untuk semua kartu loyalty dan VIP / VVIP.

items.en: Loyalty XP needed for Gold and above is lower. Monarch and Vivace are now reachable with steady play.
items.id: XP loyalty untuk Gold ke atas lebih kecil. Monarch dan Vivace bisa dicapai dengan main rutin.

items.en: Card bonuses and bet limits grow evenly between cards. No card ever goes down.
items.id: Bonus dan batas taruhan naik rata antar kartu. Kartu tidak pernah turun.

items.en: Bigger login streak and quest rewards.
items.id: Hadiah login beruntun dan quest lebih besar.

items.en: Features turned off by staff are now really off.
items.id: Fitur yang dimatikan staf sekarang benar-benar mati.
